review_rationale: Independent fresh-context source review, three rounds: doc/source_audits/batch_137.json. The reviewer re-derived unit hashes and read Tables 13.1, 13.2 and 13.3 ROW BY ROW against the PDF, independently of the author's reconstruction - necessary because extraction interleaved the columns and every future E/EN/ES fixture derives from those rows. THREE blocking findings. The integrator found the first directly: two sample plans gave a NEGATIVE result for the POSITIVE input 0.5, but SS suppresses the optional plus so the sign position must be BLANK - corrected to ' 500.000E-03' and '   5.000E-01', hand-derived and corroborated with gfortran. C137SR-001: ELEVEN units mixing an obligation with a grant of latitude were dispositioned wholly as permission - the fourth occurrence of that class this session - and were re-dispositioned to requirements with the latitude confined to rationale and oracle text; the reviewer confirmed no latitude is now wrongly asserted as an obligation. C137SR-002: placeholder plans remained, saying things like 'future plan must include exact output'; 48 entries were changed, 21 upgraded to exact executable strings and 27 marked explicitly unassertable, and the reviewer independently derived the scale-factor cases -1P,E10.3E2 giving ' 0.010E+02' and 1P,E10.3E2 giving ' 1.000E+00'. R1323 carries no diagnostic facet because it defines a hex-digit-string form and prohibits nothing. Source accounting only: authored_facets unchanged at 1977.
